ops.title: Retire bluebubbles VM: rustpush→BlueBubbles-REST shim (imsg-bridge) on metal

ops.text: One macOS guest: scripts/setup.sh writes only tart-metal + tart-hermes and machines.json has no bluebubbles entry; hermes end-to-end reply works via imsg-bridge on metal with typing indicator + read receipt + threaded reply observed in both a DM and a group; server/info reports private_api:true,helper_connected:true; imsg-bridge registers with physical-host hardware codes (never the VM identity) and survives ≥1 forced re-registration.
